name: Leonardo.Ai
summary: Generative AI platform for images and video: text-to-image, video generation, editing, upscaling and a developer API.
description: A generative AI platform for creating images and video from prompts. It offers text-to-image and video generation across many models (Seedream, Nano Banana, Flux, Lucid …), Realtime Canvas, image and video editing, universal upscaling, custom model training and a developer API. Free tier with daily fast tokens; paid plans for individuals and teams.
contains: text-to-image and video generation with models like Seedream 4.5, Nano Banana Pro, Flux.2 Pro, GPT 1.5 and Lucid
editing, Realtime Canvas and universal upscaling
free plan: 150 fast tokens per day, public creations
individual plans from $12 to $60 per month; team plans from $24 per seat
